inspection.scope: Introduction field-content definition and section 2.1 general/Z3 superpotentials, doublets and soft/gaugino terms. Targeted neutralino paragraph. Not full 144-page review.

claims.locator: atlas/FIELD_CONTENT_CONVENTIONS.md, explicit F_SM/R_SM/R_MSSM templates; source model-definition locator below
claims.value: Expand the expressly inherited SM/MSSM with its standard three families and exact representations. Dynkin maps: su(3) 3=[1,0], anti-3=[0,1], adjoint=[1,1]; su(2) d has label [d-1]. All Weyl fields are LH, including u^c,d^c,e^c. Ordinary textbook Y is used only as the declared baseline coordinate, not claimed to be individually tabulated by this source. No right-handed neutrino or additional sector is invented.

claims.locator: Introduction, PDF p.4 / printed p.3; section 2.1, PDF p.7 / printed p.6 before Eq.(2.1)
claims.value: NMSSM defined as MSSM plus one gauge-singlet chiral superfield S. Scalar S is explicitly complex and has no SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)_Y quantum numbers. Introduction also explicitly identifies its fermionic superpartner.

claims.locator: Section 2.1, PDF p.7 / printed p.6 Eqs.(2.2)-(2.5); introduction PDF p.5 / printed p.4
claims.value: Source gives Q,U_R^c,D_R^c,L,E_R^c with family indices and Hu,Hd doublets, and specifies unhatted fields are complex scalar components. Expand three inherited MSSM chiral families into one complex scalar and one LH Weyl each. Hu,Hd charges are +1/2,-1/2 in textbook Y from their component charges and inherited MSSM embedding. Source U_R^c,D_R^c,E_R^c are already conjugate chiral superfields: do not conjugate them a second time.

claims.locator: Section 2.1, PDF p.12 / printed p.11 Eq.(2.30) and preceding paragraph; PDF p.13 / printed p.12 Eqs.(2.31)-(2.32)
claims.value: One U(1) gaugino, SU(2) adjoint gauginos i=1..3, SU(3) adjoint gauginos a=1..8. Each is ONE adjoint Weyl multiplet, not 3 or 8 copies. Singlino is one independent neutral Weyl, not the auxiliary F component; neutralino mass eigenstates are not extra fields.

claims.locator: Section 2.1, PDF pp.7-8 / printed pp.6-7 Eqs.(2.1),(2.5)-(2.8)
claims.value: General NMSSM has mu,mu-prime,xi_F and associated soft terms. Z3 version sets these dimensionful superpotential terms and corresponding soft terms to zero; all chiral components transform by exp(2pi i/3). These restrictions do not change gauge/matter inventory, so one normalized candidate represents both source variants.

Normalize the inherited complete MSSM-plus-singlet inventory by q=6Y. Adjoint gauginos and singlet scalar/fermion have zero hypercharge. No auxiliary fields or Hermitian-conjugate dependent fields are counted.

duplicate_check.limits: Field-content identity only, not physical-theory equivalence. General U(1) basis mixing, simple-algebra outer automorphisms and different regimes require reconciliation. This is not an SM-embedding, anomaly or viability check.

reconciliation.policy: A newly complete correction is NOT a new model just because the old incomplete registry has no exact signature. Reuse the known legacy entry after review.
